def facts():
    w = T(np.ones((4, 32), np.float16))
    b = T(np.zeros(32, np.float16))
    opt = NN.Adam16([w, b])
    w.grad, b.grad = T(np.ones((4, 32), np.float16)), T(np.ones(32, np.float16))
    with Context(TRAINING=1):
        step = opt.schedule_step()
    return {
        "m": [t.dtype.name for t in opt.m],
        "rms": [t.dtype.name for t in opt.rms],
        "err": [t.dtype.name for t in opt.err],
        "shapes": [list(t.shape) for t in opt.m],
        "defaults": [opt.b1, opt.b2, opt.eps, opt.wd, opt.loss_scale],
        "step": len(step),
        "steps": opt.steps,
    }
